title: Detection of Small-Sized Insects in Sticky Trapping Images Using Spectral Residual Model and Machine Learning.
summary: A spectral-residual candidate detector plus SVM classifies whiteflies and thrips in sticky-trap images; separate field-image test results and agreement with manual counts support a specific crop-pest monitoring result.
